e.title: PyMC
e.summary: Python 贝叶斯推断库：理赔/准备金/死亡率建模的不确定性量化（MCMC）
e.body: PyMC（pymc-devs，GitHub 8k★+）是 Python 贝叶斯推断库：MCMC/NUTS 采样、分层模型、先验设定与后验诊断——保险领域的经典应用包括贝叶斯准备金（链梯法分层扩展）、理赔频率-严重度与死亡率建模。对 RIAA：贝叶斯方法的 Python 主力工具——与 [[stanmomo]]（Stan 贝叶斯死亡率）同属 MCMC 谱系、[[chainladder-python]]（准备金）的贝叶斯扩展方向（贝叶斯链梯）；不确定性量化是精算建模的核心（资本/准备金范围估计）；精算研究生方法课的必备技能。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：GitHub 确认（Python 贝叶斯推断库 8k★+），未实测
e.summary_en: Python Bayesian-inference library: uncertainty quantification for claims/reserving/mortality modelling (MCMC)
e.summary_hk: Python 貝葉斯推斷庫：理賠/準備金/死亡率建模的不確定性量化（MCMC）
e.body_en: PyMC (pymc-devs, 8k+ GitHub stars) is the Python Bayesian-inference library: MCMC/NUTS sampling, hierarchical models, prior specification and posterior diagnostics — classic insurance applications include Bayesian reserving (hierarchical extensions of chain-ladder), claims frequency-severity and mortality modelling. For RIAA: the main Python tool for Bayesian methods — sharing the MCMC lineage with [[stanmomo]] (Stan Bayesian mortality), and the Bayesian-extension direction of [[chainladder-python]] (reserving: Bayesian chain ladder); uncertainty quantification is core to actuarial modelling (capital/reserve range estimates); an essential skill for postgraduate actuarial methods courses.
e.body_hk: PyMC（pymc-devs，GitHub 8k★+）是 Python 貝葉斯推斷庫：MCMC/NUTS 採樣、分層模型、先驗設定與後驗診斷——保險領域的經典應用包括貝葉斯準備金（鏈梯法分層擴展）、理賠頻率-嚴重度與死亡率建模。對 RIAA：貝葉斯方法的 Python 主力工具——與 [[stanmomo]]（Stan 貝葉斯死亡率）同屬 MCMC 譜系、[[chainladder-python]]（準備金）的貝葉斯擴展方向（貝葉斯鏈梯）；不確定性量化是精算建模的核心（資本/準備金範圍估計）；精算研究生方法課的必備技能。
